title: Small Changes, Large Consequences: Analyzing the Allocational Fairness of LLMs in Hiring Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of male and female names as well as demographic-specific extracurricular activities in resumes, followed by measuring invariance violations (e.g., polarity, subjectivity, regard) in LLM-generated summaries and exclusion/non-uniformity metrics in resume retrieval and ranking.

Counterfactual substitution of Black and White sounding names as well as demographic-specific extracurricular activities in resumes, followed by measuring invariance violations (e.g., polarity, subjectivity, regard) in LLM-generated summaries and exclusion/non-uniformity metrics in resume retrieval and ranking.
